div.ab: Benedictio Dei, Patris et Filii et Spiritus sancti descendat super hoc ferrum ad discernendum uerum Dei iudicium.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 419 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: folgt XII sofort in Vt2 Mg; in Ll Tb erst nach langem anderen Stoff. Amen fügt zu Tr, wo, wiederum aus II 2—5, 3 oben S. 406 f., folgt: Oratio. Deus qui per ignem—reputetur, dann erst XII; s. nächste Seite.

XII follows immediately in Vt2 Mg; in Ll Tb only after a long stretch of other material. Tr adds Amen, and there follows, again from II 2—5, 3 above p. 406 f.: Oratio. Deus qui per ignem—reputetur, and only then XII; see next page.
